name: Waldorf Astoria Chicago
positioning: Downtown hotel in Chicago's Gold Coast with Parisian-inspired decor and a private courtyard entrance
best_for: Travelers who want a Gold Coast base in downtown Chicago
Families, with childcare, cribs and in-room touches for kids
Spa-goers who want steam rooms, a sauna and an outdoor spa terrace

facts.text: The hotel is in downtown Chicago's Gold Coast neighborhood.
Select suites have terraces and fireplaces.
The hotel has an indoor pool and a spa.
The hotel offers childcare and cribs.
Brass Tack, on the third floor, serves modern American-meets-French brasserie fare for breakfast, lunch, dinner and weekend brunch.
Rooms have a floral headboard from designer Ashley Woodson Bailey.
Kids may get teddy bears on arrival or an in-room tent set-up.
A Personal Concierge team can arrange touches such as a courtesy car for pick-ups and drop-offs.

highlights.text: The hotel has a private courtyard entrance; its motor court is credited to architect Lucien Lagrange.
Bernard's is an intimate craft cocktail and Champagne speakeasy on the second floor.
Bernard's is named for Bernard Heerey, who owned the land the hotel was built on and donated the sale proceeds to Chicago youth organizations.
The spa has eucalyptus steam rooms, a dry sauna, jacuzzis and an outdoor spa terrace.
At an annual holiday ceremony, the Gold Coast's largest tree is lit with 14,000 lights, benefiting Ann & Robert H. Lurie Children's Hospital.

considerations.text: It is a downtown city hotel, in Chicago's Gold Coast neighborhood.
Terraces and fireplaces come in select suites.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing and limited, paid on-site parking.
